item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: One Car Photo Three Sizes

turns.text: I need this car photo in three sizes: square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories. Send three separate pictures. Keep the whole car in each; blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won't work. No text.

item.tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

answer_sheet.Sizes and deliverables: Three separate images: 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16. A 640-pixel longest edge is fine.
answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The whole red car, including both ends, roof and wheels.
answer_sheet.Padding and composition: Use blurred source-photo padding wherever cropping would cut off the car. Otherwise composition is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and wording: Preserve the original photo, with no added text or restyling.

must_haves: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.

turns.text: I need this car photo in three sizes: square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories. Send three separate pictures. Keep the whole car in each; blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won't work. No text.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused all three edits because your account has insufficient credits. No pictures were created or credits spent.

Once credits are available, I can make the three separate versions—**square, 4:5, and 9:16**—with the whole car visible, blurred padding where needed, and no added text.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Reformat the supplied photograph into a square 1:1 picture. Preserve the original photo and the complete red car exactly, including all wheels and bumpers, without changing its appearance or scene. Center the original photo at a scale that keeps the whole car visible with comfortable margins. Where the target canvas extends beyond the original photo, fill with a heavily blurred enlarged copy of the same photograph as padding. Do not invent or redraw car details. No added text, titles, graphics or watermarks. Produce only this single square picture.
